brief: A contacts app as a social constellation — closeness reflects relationship, interactions glow

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor — orbs as people with glow encoding intimacy creates instant visceral and conceptual hook
Vibrant gradient avatars harmonize against the deep navy void, giving each contact a distinctive visual identity
Detail panel is well-structured with clear hierarchy: stats, recent interactions, and identity all legible
dominant_weaknesses: Constellation positions look arbitrary — closeness to center isn't legibly mapped to the 'Very close/Distant' labels in sidebar
Sidebar list and spatial canvas duplicate the same data without divergent affordances, weakening behavioral payoff
No visible connection lines, motion cues, or interaction trails — the 'interactions glow' promise is mostly static decoration
fix_priorities: Encode closeness explicitly via radial distance from a 'self' node and weight glow by recent interaction frequency
Add edges/trails between nodes that pulse on recent interactions to deliver the brief's glow metaphor
Differentiate sidebar (search/filter) from canvas (exploration) so they complement rather than mirror
Refine typography scale in detail panel — stat numbers and labels feel slightly heavy versus the airy canvas
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective lead through the constellation metaphor, but behavioral utility lags because spatial positions aren't reliably readable.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the social-constellation poetry visually, but under-delivers on the 'closeness reflects relationship' mechanic and interaction-glow feedback loop.
